Simulated dispersal tracks

Source: R/data.R
sim_tracks.Rd

Simulated GPS tracks of five dispersing individuals with hourly fixes, timing jitter and about 10\ resting during the day, also while dispersing); directed movements are biased correlated random walks, and some of them include short stopovers (0.5-1.5 days). Coordinates are in ETRS89 / UTM zone 30N (EPSG:25830), in metres.

  • "M01": settles in an area made of two nearby patches, shuttling between them, moves to a second area with a stopover on the way, makes a looping excursion and returns to the first area (with another stopover).

  • "F02": settles in one area, makes a 2.5-day stay and settles in two more areas, with a stopover before the last one.

  • "M03": settles in one area and makes a long transit with a monitoring gap of about two days.

  • "F04": home range made of two nearby patches, with two looping excursions.

  • "F05": explores with stopovers, settles briefly, departs again and the tracking ends while it is still moving.

Usage

sim_tracks

Format

A data.frame with 6 columns:

ID

Individual identifier.

timestamp

Fix time (POSIXct, UTC).

x, y

Easting and northing (m).

sex

Static individual attribute.

behaviour

Simulated behaviour: "stay" (area-restricted stay, including trips between nearby patches), "stopover" or "travel" (directed movement, including its daytime rests).

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/simulate_tracks.R in the package sources.
